description.describe_ch: 本課程是心理學現象和經濟學結合的研究，強調經濟決策決定的不確定性與有限理性、非理性。主題包括：期望理論、機率判斷偏差、直觀推斷法偏誤、自我約束與自我實現問題、心理帳戶及其對消費和儲蓄的意義、從眾行為、定錨效應與調整、偏好反轉、金融市場異常及理論、幸福經濟學…..。
description.describe_eh: This course surveys research which incorporates psychological evidence into economics, and focuses on the economic decision making under uncertainty as well as irrational and bounded-rationality .The relevant topics include the following: prospect theory, biases in probabilistic judgment, heuristics biases, self-control and self-fulfilling problem, mental accounting with implications for consumption and savings, anchoring and adjustment ,preference reversal、financial market anomalies and theories, hedonomics etc...

targets.describe_ch: 理解經濟決策的非理性、有限理性行為的現實。
targets.describe_en: Realize the economic decision making under irrational and bounded-rationality.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解各種「非理性」行為的論據
targets.describe_en: Realize the different irrational economic behaviour.

targets.describe_ch: 應用非理性行為分析於金融、行銷、個體經濟、總體經濟等主題。
targets.describe_en: Apply the irrational behavior to analyze financial,marketing,microeconomic and macroeconomic issues.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
Classroom conduct should consistently be punctual, professional, well-prepared, and courteous. The mutual respect and dignity shared among students, teachers, and other lecturers are fundamental to effective learning. To foster an environment conducive to learning, it is imperative that all participants adhere to the following guidelines for classroom behavior and contribute to a culture of respect and politeness:

1. Punctuality is crucial for all students. You are expected to arrive on time for each class unless prevented by illness or an emergency. Should you need to leave early for any reason, please notify me beforehand.
2. Please avoid talking, reading non-course material, sleeping, or partaking in any activities that are not related to the course during class time. This excludes active participation in class and group discussions, which is encouraged to minimize distractions.
3. Active listening is required when your peers are presenting or posing questions. Similarly, when it is your turn to present, ensure you speak clearly and audibly for the benefit of your group or the entire class, ensuring everyone can understand you.
4. Mobile phones must be silenced during class sessions to avoid disruptions.

課堂上的行為始終應要及時、要專業、要做好準備、要有禮貌。同學、教師或其他講師間，應保有彼此尊嚴和相互尊重，才能進行有效的學習。為了確保有利於學習環境，冀望每個人都能做到以下幾點，彼此遵守課堂行為規則，習慣禮貌的文化。
1. 學生應準時出席上課， 除非您生病或有緊急情況，否則應在上課前，要準時到達教室。如果您有某種原因必須提早下課，請提前告知。
2. 上課時請勿講話、閱讀、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除隨堂問答和分組討論外，否則應盡量減少邊際對話。
3. 當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。當您簡報時，您應該面對自己的小組或全班同學大聲說話，讓同學能聽清楚。
4. 請確保在上課時，手機調整成靜音。

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:

  • Plagiarizing others' answers during assessments constitutes cheating.

  • Repeat violators will be subject to disciplinary action in line with Feng Chia University's student disciplinary protocols.

  • 在作業、測驗或考試中作弊或抄襲的學生或協助他人的行為，該次成績以零分計。
  • 若是累犯，將依逢甲大學學生獎懲辦法提送。

policy.ais_meno_en:
• Learning must be grounded in integrity.
  • Plagiarizing others' answers during assessments constitutes cheating.
  • Similarly, submitting homework that is wholly or partly authored by someone else is considered cheating.
  • Any form of cheating or plagiarism in homework, quizzes, or exams, including assisting others in such misconduct, will result in a zero score for the affected assignment.
  • Repeat violators will be subject to disciplinary action in line with Feng Chia University's student disciplinary protocols.
